name: Pickaxe
title: pickaxe.co
shortDescription: Pickaxe enables users to build, deploy, and manage custom AI tools tailored to their specific needs. It is designed for entrepreneurs, developers, and businesses looking to leverage AI for various applications such as lead generation, workflow automation, and more. Users can monetize their AI expertise by selling tools, setting up pricing models, and tracking user engagement to optimize tool performance.
